lines.zh: 我们成群走，爪印叠在一起。
lines.en: We walk as a pack, our prints overlapping.

lines.zh: 我在队伍外沿，鼻子贴地。
lines.en: I hold the pack's edge, nose to the ground.

lines.zh: 雪地被我们踩出一条小径。
lines.en: Our feet cut a trail through the snow.

lines.zh: 我走前半步，再回头等同伴。
lines.en: I take a half step ahead, then wait for the others.

lines.zh: 林子里的风把气味带给我。
lines.en: The wind through the trees brings me scent.

lines.zh: 霜壳在爪下碎，声音很小。
lines.en: Frost crust breaks under my paws, barely a sound.

lines.zh: 这一段路，我们绕开溪水走。
lines.en: We skirt the creek along this stretch.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴垂着，走得很稳。
lines.en: My tail hangs low; my pace is even.
I don't run. Running frightens the deer.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，隔着几步。
lines.en: We go single file, a few paces apart.

lines.zh: 树影移动，我跟着它往深处走。
lines.en: The tree shadows shift, and I follow them in.

lines.zh: 我踩过一根断枝，它没响。
lines.en: I step on a dead branch. It doesn't snap.
Hoofprints in the mud. Still fresh.

lines.zh: 我们在山坡上排开，慢慢下山。
lines.en: We spread across the slope and descend.
I sit, and my ears keep moving.

lines.zh: 我卧在倒木下，尾巴盖住鼻子。
lines.en: I lie under a fallen log, tail over my nose.
A packmate calls far off. I don't answer.
My coat thickens in winter.

lines.zh: 风一停，林子安静得不对劲。
lines.en: The wind stops, and the woods feel wrong.
I test the air. Nothing.

lines.zh: 我趴下，把鼻子藏进尾巴。
lines.en: I lie down and tuck my nose into my tail.

lines.zh: 我在看鹿群会不会往回走。
lines.en: I'm watching to see if the deer turn back.

lines.zh: 我把雪刨开，找了块干地。
lines.en: I paw the snow aside for dry ground.

lines.zh: 远处有乌鸦，说明有东西死了。
lines.en: Crows in the distance. Something died.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在冷空气里成了白雾。
lines.en: My breath makes white smoke in the cold.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见树上有块布。
lines.en: I look up. A scrap of cloth in the tree.
We take turns sleeping. No one sleeps deep.
I listen. Something moves under the snow.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就先不动。
lines.en: You hold still, so I will too.
You carry the smell of deer blood.

lines.zh: 我一个人对你，不太公平。
lines.en: Me alone against you isn't quite fair.
My pack is behind you.
That bow — I'm watching your hands.

lines.zh: 我们不怕火，只是不喜欢。
lines.en: We don't fear fire. We dislike it.
You've walked into our hunting ground.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太重，鹿早跑了。
lines.en: Your steps are heavy. The deer are long gone.
You carry iron, and wood.

lines.zh: 雪地上我们的爪印叠在一起。
lines.en: Our paw prints overlap in the snow.
Open your hand and let me smell it.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会引来别的。
lines.en: I won't howl. That would bring others.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我们比你先来。
lines.en: We were in these woods before you.
Step back and I won't follow.

lines.zh: 你的靴底有鹿血，我闻得到。
lines.en: There's deer blood on your soles; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 别蹲下，蹲下我会以为你要扑。
lines.en: Don't crouch. I'd take it for a pounce.
These few paces between us are just right.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在动，别看我的脖子。
lines.en: Your eyes are moving. Don't look at my throat.
I growl and give half a step.
The pack chases deer.
Blood has matted my fur.
Tail tucked, I circle away from you.
The pain has made me wary.
I lick the wound and keep moving.

lines.zh: 后腿被划开，我瘸着退开。
lines.en: My hind leg is cut; I limp away.
My pack heard that. They'll come.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我一条腿的劲。
lines.en: That took the strength out of one leg.

lines.zh: 我不叫疼，叫了会引来别的。
lines.en: I won't cry out; that would bring others.
That meat — set it on the ground.
I smell it. Venison.

lines.zh: 森林里，我们围着麋鹿转。
lines.en: In the forest we circle the elk.
I don't eat from a person's hand.
I'll circle once, then come back.
A packmate will test it first. Don't move.
That isn't enough to share.
Three steps back, then I'll come.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子比你的眼睛准。
lines.en: My nose is surer than your eyes.
This smell is making me careless.
You knocked me and I growled low.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压到我尾巴尖了。
lines.en: Your boot came down on the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 我用肩顶你，牙齿离你手腕一寸。
lines.en: I shoulder you; my teeth stop an inch from your wrist.
My shoulder met your knee.
My fur is on you now.
I turn aside. I don't want to be hurt.

lines.zh: 这一下，林子里的鸟都飞了。
lines.en: That flushed the birds out of the trees.
You pressed in; I gave half a step.
My nose knocked your boot.
We don't collide. We go around.
That comes after winter.

lines.zh: 我要先看清你有没有伤。
lines.en: First I need to see if you're hurt.

lines.zh: 你身上没有同类的味道。
lines.en: You don't smell of our kind.
Our pack's rules are strict.

lines.zh: 你站得太直，像根伐倒的木桩。
lines.en: You stand too straight, like a felled log.
I prefer hunting together.
I need a full belly before that talk.
Don't put your hand on my neck.
We're not that sort of pair.
There are other packs beyond these woods.

lines.zh: 我们一群围猎麋鹿，不追人。
lines.en: We hunt elk as a pack, not people.

lines.zh: 麋鹿的皮，我叼回去垫窝。
lines.en: An elk hide; I'll drag it back to line the den.
I press it into the snow.

lines.zh: 闻一闻，不合口味就放回。
lines.en: One sniff, and back it goes.
This iron scrap goes to a packmate.
I bury half the meat for later.
I paw the snow aside.
Whose leather cord? I've taken it.
The pack runs ahead. I take the rear.
A cloth on the ground. Strange smell.

lines.zh: 鹿群散了，我盯住跑得慢的。
lines.en: The herd broke. I pick the slow one.
The wind favors us.
I take the left, my packmate the right.
Run, and then I'll move.

lines.zh: 我们三个，从三个方向进。
lines.en: The three of us close in from three sides.
The target's behind that fallen log.
I smell blood. Still wet.
We've closed him in the middle.
No howl this time. Straight in.
Standing still makes it harder for me.

lines.zh: 我从坡上下来，你挡不住。
lines.en: I come down the slope. You can't stop it.
The hooves broke rhythm. There's our chance.
I fix on your hind leg.

lines.zh: 追起来，我们比鹿更耐久。
lines.en: In a long chase we outlast deer.

lines.zh: 鹿群里最弱的那头，我看出来了。
lines.en: I've spotted the weakest in the herd.

lines.zh: 风向不对，我们绕到另一边。
lines.en: The wind's wrong. We'll swing to the far side.
I don't speed up. I follow first.

lines.zh: 你往林子里跑，那边有我们的。
lines.en: Run into the trees. Ours are there.

lines.zh: 雪上有你的脚印，很清楚。
lines.en: Your prints in the snow are plain.
You change direction; we change too.
Your breathing will break first.
I keep to the trees, silent.
We take turns leading. Never tired.
Glance back and you lose half a beat.
Uphill is harder for you.
I'm at your side, not behind.
The more you hurry, the worse your steps.
When this circle closes, it's over.

lines.zh: 你身边只有一棵树能挡。
lines.en: Only one tree there can shield you.

lines.zh: 你绕到左边，我的头也转过去。
lines.en: You circle left, and my head turns with you.
The snow's too deep. You can't run fast.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了就暴露位置。
lines.en: I won't howl; it would give my place away.

lines.zh: 我们一直保持着几步距离。
lines.en: We keep the same few paces of gap.

lines.zh: 你停下来喘气，就是那时候。
lines.en: You stop to breathe. That's when.
I lunge and bite your calf.
Once I bite, I don't let go.

lines.zh: 林子里的狼群，追的是鹿。
lines.en: The pack in these woods runs down deer.
You kick; I let go and lunge again.

lines.zh: 牙咬在护腿上，滑了一下。
lines.en: My teeth slipped on your leg guard.
That one drags you down.
I go for your arm. Precisely.
You raise a shield; I circle behind.
Two of us lunge at once.

lines.zh: 这一口撕开了你的袖子。
lines.en: That bite tore your sleeve open.
You retreat; I snap at your heels.
I leap and reach your shoulder.
You fall in the snow, and I'm on you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你背上留下几道。
lines.en: My claws leave lines across your back.

lines.zh: 你挥刀，我退开半步再上。
lines.en: You swing; I give half a step and come back.

lines.zh: 这一下，你手里的东西掉了。
lines.en: That knocked what you held out of your hand.
A few more pairs of eyes in the trees.

lines.zh: 雪坡上探出我的鼻子，然后是眼。
lines.en: My nose shows over the snowbank, then my eyes.

lines.zh: 我们一共有四只，散开站着。
lines.en: There are four of us, spread out.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子抬高，闻这片林子。
lines.en: I raise my nose and read these woods.

lines.zh: 地上的雪还是新的，我踩上去。
lines.en: The snow's fresh. I step onto it.

lines.zh: 我们跟着鹿群到了这里。
lines.en: We followed the deer to this place.

lines.zh: 这地方有水源，适合久待。
lines.en: There's water here. Good for staying.

lines.zh: 我从山坡上下来，慢慢跑。
lines.en: I come down the slope at a slow run.

lines.zh: 我从结冰的溪边过来，毛还湿着。
lines.en: I come from the frozen creek, my fur still wet.
A long howl comes from far off.

lines.zh: 我先绕着这块地走了一圈。
lines.en: I walk one full circle of this ground first.

lines.zh: 我在一棵树下留了记号。
lines.en: I leave a mark at the base of a tree.

lines.zh: 林线那边，我们排成一列。
lines.en: At the treeline we form a line.

lines.zh: 我们在这片林子里过夜。
lines.en: We'll spend the night in these woods.
I catch an unfamiliar scent.

lines.zh: 狼群在雪线后集合，我走在头里。
lines.en: The pack gathers behind the snowline; I take the lead.

lines.zh: 雪地上先出现的是我的影子。
lines.en: My shadow shows on the snow first.

lines.zh: 群里的头狼走在最前面。
lines.en: The lead wolf walks at the front.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，一股焦味散开。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur and a burnt smell spreads.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，撞在树上。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and hit a tree.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我拼命刨。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I claw for the bank.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到雪里，半天才起。
lines.en: The blast buries me in snow; I take a while to rise.
An arrow bites my ribs.

lines.zh: 有股力量扯我，我的毛都竖了。
lines.en: A force drags at me and my fur stands up.
Hungry enough that my legs fail.

lines.zh: 雷打中旁边的树，我耳朵嗡了半天。
lines.en: Lightning strikes a nearby tree; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我的爪子抓不住。
lines.en: No soil in the void; my claws find nothing.
